# Netflix

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `dark` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, and keeps the 10 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: Signed-out streaming marketing: black page, red action, translucent field chrome, gradient reason cards, square FAQ rows.

Captured 2026-11-19, signed out. Public marketing and login chrome only. No account, no card, no playback.. Themes: dark.

Public signed-out marketing and login chrome for Netflix, captured 2026-11-19 from https://www.netflix.com/sg/ (redirected from https://www.netflix.com/) and https://www.netflix.com/sg/login. No account. English. One dark theme. Desktop readings are at innerWidth 1169, innerHeight 731, devicePixelRatio 2. Phone readings are the login page at innerWidth 390, innerHeight 844, devicePixelRatio 2. A 1440 CSS-pixel width was not reached.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots; they are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.

### What to distrust (from README.md)

- Hover, pressed, disabled, error, success, and warning colours are declared custom properties. They were not painted on the page.
- The FAQ answer set `aria-expanded` to true and kept a painted height of 0. The open panel is a gap.
- The hero scrim gradient was truncated at 160 characters. The two colour stops of the value-card gradient were read in full.
- The inline N logo's third path was truncated, so that SVG was not saved. The wordmark SVG was fetched from the `BrandNetflixLogotype` image URL.
- [screenshots/home-dark-unavailable.png](screenshots/home-dark-unavailable.png) is a black label, not a capture of the page. Do not sample colours from it.
- The login URL carried a `serverState` query. That value is not stored here.
- Singapore pricing copy ("Starts at $15.98") is locale content, not a token.

### Do and don't (from README.md)

- **Use the red action for the one next step.** Sign In, Get Started, and Continue share `#e50914`, white type, and a 4px radius.
- **Keep the page black and the type white.** Secondary copy is white at 70%.
- **Put fields on the translucent charcoal chrome.** `rgba(22, 22, 22, 0.7)` with a 1px grey border, not a white input.
- **Do not invent a light theme.** These pages do not switch.
- **Do not draw a drop shadow on these controls.** None was measured.
- **Do not treat declared hover colours as a painted capture.** They are stylesheet values.
